title: Not yet planning to stay: the car bought in Germany
summary: Waters says he only wanted to see Paris and Europe, and recounts buying a car in Germany to ship to New York and the tax trouble that followed.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: At this point in time, had you made your decision to stay? Or were you just takin' it one day, one week at a time, one gig at a time?
Yeah. I really didn't make my decision to stay, not like I did. I just wanted to see Paris and see a little bit of Europe, now my idea was to see Europe also.

You understand, I had never been there before. But the rea-, but I didn't make it, idea of staying, I'll tell you why. Because I went to Germany quite a long time after that 'cause I quit Bill, went back. But I quit him one time, after a couple tours I quit him and went to Germany, see. And I bought a little car in Germany, and I bought it, the car - there was international license, what do you those licenses, from there you can go a lot of countries. [ ] -
International, diplomatic plates, I don't know -
Yeah, [ ], it's a plate that you can, you have to go to take it home with you -

Yeah anyway I went back. And then I heard of the idea of taking the car into New York, see? And I got in a lot of trouble [ ], 'cause the guy made me pay for it in France. Because if I didn't take it to New York, then I had to pay the taxes, everything cost me and I had - make me pay the taxes. But that's my idea, see, they - so my idea wasn't to stay. But that happened, I got one job after another, see, one job after another coming up, in particular when we got the Cigalle deal, you know. I left Bill, that was after It-, a tour of Italy that I left Bill -
